primary.title: 8th Pay Commission: How higher basic pay could boost your earnings over 20 years – Expert explains
primary.summary: The 8th Pay Commission is holding consultations in Mumbai on 22-23 October. Unions have sought a minimum basic pay of ₹69,000-72,000 and higher increments. An expert explains how a higher basic pay can raise DA, HRA, pension and gratuity over a 20-year career. These are proposals, not approved.
